scope: Fixed eight-drug development analysis; no CTRP response use. Freeze protocol/config before formal outcomes, preserving previously observed pilot results.
model_selection_objective: Minimum pooled inner OOF RMSE in original GDSC drug-response AUC units; unchanged across molecular models.
primary_estimand: For each drug, arithmetic mean of three complete-OOF Spearman correlations for REO200 EN minus corresponding mean for expression2000 EN; equal-weight eight-drug macro mean of those differences.
repeat_aggregation: Calculate each metric separately in each complete repeat, then arithmetic mean of the three metrics. Do not concatenate repeat rows as independent samples; do not average repeat predictions before calculating Spearman.

paired_effect_directions.spearman: candidate minus reference; positive favors candidate
paired_effect_directions.rmse: reference minus candidate; positive favors candidate
paired_effect_directions.mae: reference minus candidate; positive favors candidate
paired_effect_directions.r2: candidate minus reference; positive favors candidate
paired_effect_directions.relative_rmse_improvement: Within each repeat, (reference RMSE-candidate RMSE)/reference RMSE; average the three ratios; denominator zero yields NA.

macro_rule: Equal-weight all eight fixed drugs, after repeat-level averaging. Any undefined constituent gives primary/secondary macro NA; never silently nanmean or replace/remove tasks.

bootstrap.global_group_order: Lexicographic sorted unique biological_group_id in the full eight-drug v2 development manifest
bootstrap.resampling: Draw N_global groups with replacement from N_global groups, retaining every source model/observation in each sampled group with that group's multiplicity. Generate one shared count matrix and reuse each draw across all drugs, models and repeats.
bootstrap.group_count_algorithm: numpy Generator(PCG64).multinomial(N_global, uniform group probabilities, size=B); equivalent to ID sampling with replacement. Save seed, group-order/hash, count-matrix hash and generation versions.
bootstrap.drug_missingness: Keep the frozen drug-specific observation set; absent drug observations stay absent. The number of sampled rows per drug may vary across shared global draws.
bootstrap.spearman: Recompute bootstrap ranks with exact ties. Multiplicity-weighted mid-ranks are permitted only if verified equal to explicit duplicated-observation Spearman; resampling precomputed original ranks and correlating them is not the same statistic.
bootstrap.invalid_draw_policy: Report requested/valid/invalid draws and reason. Withhold interval if point estimand undefined or valid fraction<0.99. If adequate, quantile valid draws while explicitly reporting invalid counts; retain every planned drug/estimand.
bootstrap.interval_scope: Conditional resampling intervals for the observed outcome/OOF-prediction records. No training or tuning is refitted; intervals do not cover full training-algorithm uncertainty or guarantee coverage for nested-CV generalization performance.

multiplicity.primary_family: Nine Spearman-difference estimands: eight prespecified drugs plus one equal-drug macro for REO EN versus expression EN.
multiplicity.secondary_family: Separate nine-estimand Spearman-difference family for REO RF versus expression RF; exploratory secondary, not a second route to declare the main EN successful.
multiplicity.adjustment: Bonferroni percentile endpoints alpha/(2*9) and 1-alpha/(2*9); also report marginal 95% intervals.
multiplicity.interpretation: Nominal family-adjusted conditional bootstrap intervals, not exact simultaneous coverage of algorithmic performance. Primary and secondary families are distinct; no combined guarantee across both families.
multiplicity.auxiliary_metrics: Unadjusted 95% conditional intervals, labelled descriptive; no multiplicity-unadjusted confirmatory claims.

repeat_stability: Three complete-repeat metric/effect values, min/max/range and sample SD(ddof=1); descriptive variation only, not a three-independent-study standard error or confidence interval.

undefined_policy.training_mean_spearman: Always NA as an individual-ranking baseline, even if concatenated fold means differ.
undefined_policy.constant_response_or_prediction: Spearman NA with reason; R2 NA for constant response; preserve RMSE/MAE and task records.
undefined_policy.missing_prediction_or_incomplete_repeat: Retain and flag task as incomplete. Do not calculate primary mean/CI from a subset of its three repeats or silently reduce N.
undefined_policy.zero_molecular_coefficients: Preserve global prediction metrics but identify tissue-only EN components; global Spearman is not molecular evidence.

minimum_meaningful_effect: Not established. Report effect sizes/precision and practical scale without inventing a post-hoc success/equivalence threshold.
corrected_repeat_cv_mse_ci: Not included. A correction of fold-level MSE does not validate Spearman/bootstrap algorithmic intervals; dependence/stability assumptions are not established for these tuned pipelines.
formal_inference_limit: Development-only evidence cannot establish independent-screen transfer, clinical utility, or universal REO superiority. Frozen CTRP evaluation and full analysis are separate gates.

literature.authors: Bates S, Hastie T, Tibshirani R
literature.title: Cross-Validation: What Does It Estimate and How Well Does It Do It?
literature.journal: Journal of the American Statistical Association
